name: Angoth
description: Angoth was a small planet that featured woods and a ring of scattered asteroids. During the High Republic Era, a settlement existed on Angoth, and the Nihil marauders also established a base in a former detention center for smugglers. The Jedi Order and Republic Defense Coalition embarked on a mission to capture one of the Nihil's Nameless creatures from the base on Angoth.
